blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The most advanced ball pouch underwear…
blocks_element.text: The most advanced ball pouch underwear for men. The Elite II Boxer Brief is built with an upgraded and patented Paradise Pocket ball pouch design to provide unparalleled comfort by separating your “boys” from your thighs. No more awkward sumo squat or elongated side step - just life-changing comfort and adjustment-free days.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We used a custom built, eco-friendly, …
blocks_element.text: We used a custom built, eco-friendly, high performance microfiber to make this ball pouch underwear more luxurious, durable, breathable, sweat-wicking, quick-drying, stretchy, incredibly soft, anti-odor and anti-chafing. To push breathability even further, we added mesh Breathe Zones for more airflow and uncompromising ventilation where you need it most. Bye, swamp crotch.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Then, inspired by the smart grip syste…
blocks_element.text: Then, inspired by the smart grip systems in high-end cycling apparel, we created Power Grip - laser-cut wide leg grippers lined with soft silicone for incredible hold. The legs will never ride up or bunch, so no more awkwardly tugging your pants to pull the legs down. The Power Grip also stays hidden, even under tighter pants, so no more visible underwear lines either.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · This pair packs all the features you n…
blocks_element.text: This pair packs all the features you need for work, sweat, play and everything in between (because you’ve got better things to do than remembering to pack an extra pair): a horizontal fly for a more natural movement when nature calls, reinforced stress points for extra durability to last for years, and 15+ other smart features for more comfort, performance and durability. View our fit guide here.

Paragraphe · I have tried many different brands inc…
blocks_element.text: I have tried many different brands including SAXX, Separatec, Shinesty, MeUndies and another model from All Citizens. These are by far the best in performance. Moisture wicking is good, the smart grip system really works, the camo print design is the best and the pouch secures the jewels better than all the other brands by far. They really keep my jewels separate from my thighs so chaffing is not a problem.
